intro: **sot** is a system monitor for the terminal, in the spirit of [top](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Top_(software)).
CPU, memory, GPU, disks, network and processes in one live dashboard, plus tools to inspect your machine, benchmark disks and free up space. Works on macOS, Linux and Windows.

views.name: Overview
views.shows: CPU per core, health score, top processes, memory, GPU, disk, network and socket graphs

views.name: Processes
views.shows: Process table, listening ports and dev environments

views.name: Disks
views.shows: Physical disks and partitions, usage bars, read/write stats

views.name: System
views.shows: What sot info prints, with uptime, memory and battery kept live

views.name: Bench
views.shows: Pick a disk and watch each benchmark finish

views.name: Clean
views.shows: Scan, tick what to remove, dry run or clean

commands.does: Live dashboard: CPU, memory, GPU, disk, network, connections and processes
Processes, listening ports and running dev environments
Every physical disk with its partitions, usage and I/O
System summary with an OS logo, like neofetch
Disk benchmark: sequential throughput, random IOPS and latency
Find and remove caches, logs, temp files and build output
Move to a newer release, through the tool that installed sot
